response.sql: WITH trans_account_district AS (SELECT t.account_id, t.amount, d.A3 as region FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), account_region_stats AS (SELECT account_id, region, SUM(amount) as account_sum, COUNT(*) as transaction_count FROM trans_account_district GROUP BY account_id, region), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(account_sum) as region_total FROM account_region_stats GROUP BY region) SELECT ars.account_id, ars.region, ars.account_sum, ars.transaction_count, CASE WHEN rt.region_total IS NOT NULL AND rt.region_total > 0 THEN CAST(ars.account_sum AS REAL) / rt.region_total ELSE NULL END as share FROM account_region_stats ars LEFT JOIN region_totals rt ON ars.region = rt.region ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
